about_the_game:
Color Me Silly is a memory, brain teaser game where you're challenged to push the limits as the game gets harder and new mechanics are introduced. Decipher the key to choose the right card, and compete against yourself and others with our self-hosted leaderboards!

Challenge Your Mind!

Confusing to look at, easy to intuit, but hard to master! Challenge your mind to solve each round's puzzle as you gradually become fluent in the language of Color Me Silly.

Fun for all ages, play Color Me Silly's wordle like daily puzzles and impress your friends and family with your ability to decipher the code of numbers, colors, and shapes!

Developed By Some Guy!

Inspired by memory and brainteaser games, with the goal of creating a game that looks confusing at first but can be simplified into easy heuristics that gets more intuitive as you play more.. Color Me Silly was born and is finally playable! Made with love and care by the solo developer, not_absent. This game is my first game project release, and with lots of struggles and learning the first demo is live.

Future Plans

There are still several features, rewards, and additions that are in the works and will slowly be added as we ramp up towards a full release. Here are a few of the current features in development:

- Daily global seeded puzzles! Compete with friends and see who can solve the puzzle first!

- Gameplay rewards: cosmetic varieties, custom difficulty scaling & point rewards!

- Fixing options & settings 

- Squashing bugs that I'm sure we'll run into together as the game goes live! 

Please comment or message any suggestions or bugs, I really appreciate it and read everything. Follow Polymonolith for dev logs of Color Me Silly and upcoming projects as we continue working on Color Me Silly and future projects so follow along and stay silly
